## How it was verified

- [ ] `tools/check.sh` passes (it is what CI runs); add `--gui` for interface changes and `--packages` for packaging changes
- [ ] A screenshot is attached if the interface changed
- [ ] Verified on real hardware (controller model, connection, how many runs), or says plainly that it was not
- [ ] Devlog entry added (`DEVLOG.md`) in this same change, when it is worth remembering
- [ ] Docs updated in this same change (README, `docs/`) if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] If a controller family is promoted to `validated`, a reproducible test is attached

Please remove full MAC addresses, serial numbers and personal paths from anything you paste.
